title: Austin's Bridge, Beach Fill & Sewer Rules
summary:
*   Many residents received extensions, mostly until January 1918, to connect their properties to the city's sewer system, signaling a city-wide push for improved sanitation.
*   The city approved a $1,077 contract to fill large holes on the "sand beach" (likely a recreational area) and released a contractor's bond for a recently completed concrete bridge.
*   An attorney was compensated for collecting delinquent personal property taxes, and a local lodge for locomotive firemen secured a low-cost rental for meeting space at a city fire hall.

Willie Carpenter

extension

motion time until January 1st 1918 was granted by the following vote: Yeas Mayor

L Cohn
Time sewer
extension
Application of L Cohn for time in which to connect with sewer was presented, and on motion
time was extended until January 1st 1918, on three of the houses, and 3 months longer in

Councilmen Anthony, Bartholomew, Haynes & Powell 5 Nays none:
Mr C Ferd

but no action taken on same:

Councilman Powell offered the following resolution : Whereas, on the 21st day of Sept
1916, a contract was entered into between the City of Austin, Texas, a municipal
corporation, acting by and through its Mayor, A P Wooldridge, as party of the first part,
and Hugo Brueggermann, a resident of Travis County, Texas, as party of the 2nd part, for
the construction of a concrete bridge across Waller creek at 15th street; and, Whereas,
the said Hugo Brueggermann, has fulfilled his contract with the City of Austin, Texas,
Therefore,
Be it resolved by the City Council of the City of Austin, Texas: That the said Hugo
Brueggermanns bondsmen, The American Surety Company of New York, be and the same are
hereby released and discharged from all further liability on said contract. Bond of Hugo
Brueggermann
released
The resolution was adopted by the following vote: Yeas Mayor Wooldridge, Councilmen
Anthony, Bartholomew, Haynes & Powell 5 Nays none:
Approved, A P Wooldridge, Mayor:
Mayor Wooldridge offered the following resolution : Resolved by the City Council of the

list which is made the basis of this appropriation.
The total amount collected is $ 1,153.38. the percentage of same at 25cents on the $1.00,

Councilman Bartholomew offered the following resolution : Resolved by the City Council of
the City of Austin, Texas : Mr. Capps That the City of Austin here contr cts with T J

three (3) feet above low water ,as marked by stakes and pipes upon the ground fixed by S S
Posey, Engineer in the Water, Light and Power department of this City,and agreed to by the
said T J Capps for the lump sum of onethousand and seventy seven ($ 1,077.00) dollars,
which sum of $ 1,077.00) is to be paid to the said T J Capps upon completion of the work

The material at no point is to be left below the level is to be fairly level.
The particulars of the contract authorized by this resolution are set out in a

Light and Power department ,and attached to this resolution as a basis for the same .

Bank and Trust Company of this City.
